traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Humiriaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire, crenate or serrate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules present or absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in panicles; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 10 to 100; carpels (4-) 5 (-7). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
